title: AxoMines
description: AxoMines is an easy-to-use plugin for creating and managing automatic mines, featuring configurable regions, rewards, resets, and intuitive menus for both administrators and players.
body:
# AxoMines

A plugin for creating, editing, and managing automatic mines on Minecraft servers.

Includes scheduled resets, visual region selection, block rewards, and fully configurable menus.

## ✨ Features

* Create and edit mines through an intuitive GUI.
* Built-in region selector with particles and configurable tool.
* Automatic mine resets based on time or mined percentage.
* Safe support for Paper and Folia.
* Block rewards with items, commands, and experience.
* Configurable messages, sounds, action bars, and particles.
* Integrated placeholder system.
* YAML-based storage.

## 📦 Requirements

* Java 25 or higher.
* Paper or Folia.
* Minecraft 1.21.11

## 🔌 Optional Plugins

* PlaceholderAPI
* Vault
* LuckPerms
